calibration: Initial release-regression policy accepted on 2026-10-26 after three exploratory local runs: Apple M1 Pro / macOS arm64, Node 24.22.1, Prisma and pg adapter 7.9.1, Docker PostgreSQL 16, pool max 4, concurrency 1 and 4. Formal protocol: 100 warmups and 1000 measured operations per block, 5 paired repeats. This policy is local to the recorded environment, not a statistically calibrated production SLO. P99 above 1.25 is advisory and deliberately excluded from gating rules.
